# Review Checklist Instructions

Stand: 2026-06-17  
Status: Active

Review against:

- Product Fit
- Dashboard 5-second test
- V5 Visual Design
- UX / IA
- Accessibility
- Security / Privacy
- Code quality

Fail if:

- Today/Daily Control are not dominant.
- Inbox or Review is hidden.
- Old dashboard variants become active.
- UI becomes generic AI-slop.
- Color is the only status signal.
- Mobile breaks.
